Name: Co-op Config Sync
Author: TypicalVolpe
Description:
[size=5][b]Host Config Sync[/b][/size]
Everyone plays with the host's mod settings. The host can require it.

[size=4][b]A note first[/b][/size]
I made this mainly for myself and my own multiplayer games. I built it with AI assistance (Claude by Anthropic). Nexus doesn't allow mods to be private or hidden, so it's public here. It's shared as is: use it if it helps, but expect rough edges and back up your saves.

[size=4][b]IMPORTANT: the host AND every joining player need this mod, on the same version.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What it does[/b][/size]
In modded multiplayer, everyone's mod settings (config.json) can differ, which causes confusion. Host Config Sync makes the host's settings the standard.
[list]
[*][b]Force mode (on by default):[/b] joining players must match the host. Their configs are updated automatically, then they restart and rejoin. Players are removed from the game if they: lack this mod, are missing any of the host's mods, run a different version of a mod, fail to sync, or change their settings after joining.[/*]
[*][b]Full mod list check:[/b] the host's whole mod list is compared, not only mods that have a config.json.[/*]
[*][b]Choice mode:[/b] the host can turn force off. Joiners then get a prompt: Apply / [b]List[/b] / Not now. "List" shows every mod that differs, page by page.[/*]
[*][b]Host notifications:[/b] the host sees in game (banner and chat) which configs differ, which mods a joiner is missing, and what was updated or failed.[/*]
[*][b]Sync status:[/b] a result message shows what was updated, what failed and what is still missing. The SMAPI console command hcs_status prints the full list.[/*]
[*][b]Locked mod options:[/b] joining players can't open Generic Mod Config Menu in the host's world (on by default; the host can unlock).[/*]
[*][b]Removal notice:[/b] a removed player sees the reason on the title screen.[/*]
[*][b]Backups:[/b] old config files are saved to a backups folder before being replaced.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]If syncing fails[/b][/size]
Turn force off: type [b]hcs_force off[/b] in the SMAPI console, or use the switch on this mod's page in Generic Mod Config Menu.

[size=4][b]Host commands (SMAPI console)[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]hcs_force on|off[/b]: require joiners to match, or not[/*]
[*][b]hcs_options lock|unlock[/b]: block or allow mod option menus for joiners[/*]
[*][b]hcs_mods[/b]: list every mod ID[/*]
[*][b]hcs_exclude add|remove ModId[/b]: skip a mod (not synced, not required)[/*]
[*][b]hcs_status[/b] (joiner): show what matches, updated, differs, failed or is missing[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+, SMAPI 4.0+[/*]
[*]Host and all joining players have the mod (same version)[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu is optional (for the in-game settings page)[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
Install like any SMAPI mod (Vortex or manually into the Mods folder). Everyone in the game needs it.

[size=4][b]Settings (config.json)[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]ForceHostConfig[/b] (true): joiners must match the host.[/*]
[*][b]ForceGraceSeconds[/b] (180): time a joiner has to finish matching.[/*]
[*][b]CheckModList[/b] (true): require the host's full mod list and versions.[/*]
[*][b]FarmhandsCanEditModOptions[/b] (false): true lets joiners open mod option menus.[/*]
[*][b]LockedMenuNamespaces[/b] (["GenericModConfigMenu"]): menus closed while locked.[/*]
[*][b]ExcludedModIds[/b]: mods never synced or required (use for personal mods like keybinds, and host-only mods).[/*]
[*][b]IncludedModIds[/b]: if set, only these mods have configs synced.[/*]
[*][b]ShareConfigsAsHost, SyncConfigsAsFarmhand, AutoApply[/b]: for choice mode.[/*]
[*][b]MaxFileSizeKB[/b] (256): larger config files are skipped.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Known limitations[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Joiners must restart the game after their configs are updated. Other mods can't reload their settings while the game runs.[/*]
[*]It's an honor-system check. A modified game could report false results to the host.[/*]
[*]Only mods with a config.json are config-checked. The mod list check covers the rest.[/*]
[*]Mods that rewrite their own config while running may look like "changes" and get a player removed. Add them to ExcludedModIds.[/*]
[*]Host-only or visual-only mods the joiners don't need should be added to ExcludedModIds, or joiners will be blocked.[/*]
[*]Unlocking mod options while force is on works against itself: changing a setting gets the player removed.[/*]
[*]Split-screen joiners are not supported in force mode.[/*]
[*]Both host and joiners need the same version of this mod.[/*]
[*]Removal uses the game's built-in kick. I couldn't test every setup.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Source[/b][/size]
The source code is included in the download.

Manifest.Name: Host Config Sync
Manifest.Description: In multiplayer, farmhands can pull the host's mod config.json files so everyone's settings match. Asks before changing anything and backs up your files first.
